name: Shelf
description: Drop files, links and text on the notch to keep them for a moment, then drag them out where they go.
author: sadeqi-ah

preferences.name: keepCopy
preferences.title: Keep a copy of dropped files
preferences.description: The Shelf keeps its own copy, so a file stays even if the original is moved or deleted. Copies are deleted when you remove them from the Shelf.

preferences.name: removeAfterDrag
preferences.title: Remove files after dragging them out
preferences.description: A file you drag from the Shelf to Finder or any app leaves the Shelf, so it empties as you go.
